Legendary: A Review of the Timeless Movie "Legend"

Originally published 22 April 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Film Reviews

Are you ready to embark on a journey into a mystical world filled with magic, adventure, and romance? Then look no further than the 1985 fantasy film "Legend," directed by Ridley Scott. This visually stunning movie has captivated audiences for decades with its breathtaking visuals, enchanting story, and unforgettable characters. Let's dive into the mystical realm of "Legend" and explore why this movie has become a timeless legend in its own right.

"Legend" is set in a dark and mythical forest where light and darkness are in constant battle. The story revolves around a young and innocent princess named Lily, portrayed by Mia Sara, who becomes entangled in a battle between good and evil when she is lured into the lair of the Lord of Darkness, played by the incomparable Tim Curry. Tom Cruise stars as Jack, a forest dweller who must embark on a heroic quest to save Lily and defeat the Lord of Darkness. Along the way, Jack encounters a host of colorful characters, including a mischievous fairy named Oona, played by Annabelle Lanyon, and a band of eccentric goblins led by Blix, played by Alice Playten. As the battle between light and darkness intensifies, Jack must find the courage to face his fears, overcome obstacles, and ultimately save the day.

One of the most mesmerizing aspects of "Legend" is its visual splendor. Ridley Scott is known for his masterful use of visuals, and "Legend" is no exception. The film features stunning cinematography by Alex Thomson, who captures the ethereal beauty of the forest and its inhabitants with breathtaking precision. The use of practical effects, such as intricate costumes, elaborate sets, and stunning makeup, adds to the film's visual grandeur, creating a truly immersive experience for the audience.

The standout performance in "Legend" is undoubtedly Tim Curry's portrayal of the Lord of Darkness. With his commanding presence, devilish charm, and mesmerizing voice, Curry brings the character to life in a way that is both terrifying and captivating. His performance is a masterclass in villainy, and he steals every scene he's in, making the Lord of Darkness one of the most iconic movie villains of all time.

The chemistry between Tom Cruise and Mia Sara as Jack and Lily is another highlight of the film. Their innocent and pure love is the driving force behind Jack's heroic quest, and their emotional connection is palpable on screen. Cruise portrays Jack as a charismatic and determined hero, while Sara brings depth and vulnerability to Lily, making her more than just a damsel in distress. Their performances anchor the film and give it an emotional weight that resonates with audiences.

Another standout aspect of "Legend" is its mesmerizing score by Jerry Goldsmith. The film's hauntingly beautiful music perfectly complements the visuals and enhances the emotional impact of the story. From the whimsical melody of the fairy dance to the powerful and majestic theme of the Lord of Darkness, the score adds depth and dimension to the film, elevating it to a cinematic masterpiece.

"Legend" is not just a visual and auditory feast, but also a tale of universal themes such as the battle between good and evil, the power of love, and the importance of self-sacrifice. Through its fantastical setting and characters, the film explores the timeless themes of courage, heroism, and the enduring power of hope. It reminds us that even in the darkest of times, there is always a glimmer of light that can guide us towards victory.

Despite its critical and commercial underperformance upon its initial release, "Legend" has gained a cult following over the years, and it continues to enthrall audiences with its enduring charm and magic.
